ideas.pitch: A mobile application tailored for local municipalities to incentivize household waste segregation through QR-coded drop-off bins and token rewards.
ideas.title: EcoKottayam Waste-to-Reward Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with UN Sustainable Development Goal 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) and mirrors proven winning mechanics from past sustainability hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight dashboard and mobile tracker for local panchayats and community bodies to log water pump maintenance logs, pipe leakage complaints, and resource distribution.
ideas.title: JalSetu Local Water Asset Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets UN SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) with a practical governance tool modeled after major national hackathon runners-up.

ideas.pitch: A crowdsourced mobile platform enabling commuters to log pothole coordinates, unlit street corners, and road damage with automated severity scoring for civic bodies.
ideas.title: MargMitra Kerala Road Hazard Reporter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses UN SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) by offering an immediately deployable safety asset for local infrastructure management.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile app using a lightweight computer vision model to diagnose common crop blights in regional staple crops, connecting farmers with local cooperative solutions.
ideas.title: AgriYield Local Crop Disease Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on UN SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) by delivering actionable agricultural support tailored to regional farming contexts.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered dashboard for local rural artisans and small shops to track carbon footprint reduction metrics and generate localized digital promotions.
ideas.title: GreenShop AI Local Commerce Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines UN SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) with the winning blueprint of combining small business tools and impact reporting.
